name: Slack Canvas
description: Slack Canvas provides collaborative documents inside Slack for channel resources, project plans, onboarding guides, incident notes, and other shared context.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Slack app token, then let selected agents find canvas section IDs, draft content locally, or create and append bounded markdown under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: SLACK_CANVAS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Slack Canvas app token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A bot or user token from the customer's own Slack app with canvases:read and canvases:write. Railway stores it encrypted and sends it only to slack.com/api.

capabilities.label: Find canvas sections
capabilities.description: Find bounded section IDs in one explicit canvas.

capabilities.label: Create and append canvas content
capabilities.description: Create a bounded standalone canvas or append markdown to one explicit canvas.

allowed.label: Find canvas sections
allowed.description: Find bounded section IDs in one explicit canvas using supported heading and text criteria.

allowed.label: Draft canvas content
allowed.description: Prepare bounded Slack Canvas markdown locally without a provider side effect.

approvalRequired.label: Create standalone canvas
approvalRequired.description: Create one standalone canvas with bounded title and markdown content.

approvalRequired.label: Append canvas content
approvalRequired.description: Append bounded markdown to the start or end of one explicit writable canvas.

blocked.label: Destructive canvas changes
blocked.description: Canvas deletion, section deletion, whole-document replacement, and arbitrary section-relative edits are not exposed.

blocked.label: Canvas access changes
blocked.description: Ownership transfer and user or channel access grants and revocations are not exposed.

blocked.label: Sensitive content expansion
blocked.description: File downloads, broad canvas discovery, private-channel enumeration, and automatic content export are not exposed.

blocked.label: Raw Slack APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary Slack methods, caller-selected origins, raw tokens, and unbounded requests are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Section lookup and local drafting run directly; each canvas creation or append requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected create and append operations run without Relay per-action approval while fixed methods, bounds, audits, Slack scopes, workspace access, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts four typed Slack Canvas tools and attaches the encrypted customer token server-side.
Railway mounts four typed Slack Canvas tools and attaches the encrypted customer token server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A Slack workspace owner must create the customer's own app, grant canvases:read and canvases:write, install it to the intended workspace, and enter the resulting bot or user token in Relay.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create and install a least-privilege customer-owned Slack app, connect its token, verify the exact workspace and accessible canvases, test Safe approvals and Dangerous writes, then test token revocation and disconnect.

evidence.supports: Slack documents standalone and channel canvases, markdown content, and supported Canvas API formatting.
Slack documents canvases.sections.lookup with canvases:read, exact canvas IDs, heading/text criteria, and section-ID responses.
Slack documents standalone canvas creation with canvases:write, bounded title, and markdown document content.
Slack documents one edit operation per call, including insert_at_start and insert_at_end used by Relay's append-only wrapper.
Slack documents canvases:read for accessing canvas contents through section lookup.
Slack documents canvases:write for create, edit, delete, and access methods; Relay mounts only create and append-only edit.
